div.div: فَرْمٌ , (T, S, M, K,) and ↓ فَرْمَةٌ , (S, K,) and ↓ فِرَامٌ , (M, K,) A medicament, or remedial application, (T, S, M, K,) such as the stones of raisins, (T, M,) used by a woman for the purpose of contracting her vulva, or vagina. (T, S, M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
